description: Default permissions for the main Pincel window. M11.2 adds `dialog:default` for the native open / save pickers; `core:window:allow-destroy` lets the UI close the window after its unsaved-changes prompt (docs/specs/unsaved-changes-prompt.md); the read_file_bytes / write_file_bytes commands wrap std::fs directly, so no fs-plugin permissions are needed; `clipboard-manager:allow-read-image` lets the start screen offer a clipboard image (docs/specs/copy-cut-paste.md AC-27 – AC-33) — read-image only, no other clipboard command.
